title: Angry Owens gives Mishlove a sore throat over the phone
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Angry Owens gives Mishlove a sore throat over the phone, about late 1976 at phone call to Mishlove, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He got angry and within minutes I could feel this sensation in my throat

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a psychologist with a doctorate who studies psychic claims, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a phone call in late 1976 with Ted Owens, a man who claimed psychic powers. Mishlove says Owens got angry with him and within minutes he felt a strange sensation in his throat, as if Owens could affect him from a distance.
